description: What went into an application form, question by question. Call it with submitted true once the candidate says the application went in, with each field as they filled it, never on a guess: the role is logged as applied in their tracker, answers to questions their records did not cover are kept so the next form asks fewer, and the form's questions (never the answers) are kept so the next candidate applying to this posting gets the full list. With submitted false it only checks answers against their records (every answer that differs comes back in mismatches) and logs nothing. Send each field's label as the form prints it, its type and options when you have them, and the value. Leave out self-identification answers, ID numbers and passwords: a card or government ID number, a password or a token is refused and nothing is saved.
name: report_application
title: Report an application form
